ambulance.basis: ESTIMATED_DATA. Origin, destination and departure time are configuration choices by this project, not a real EMS dispatch. No ambulance call record for Silk Board was available.
ambulance.priority_in_this_phase: none — obeys normal traffic rules; siren and signal preemption are Phase 5

ambulance.note: SIMULATED_DATA. The travel time of a simulated ambulance through simulated traffic, with no priority of any kind. Not a measurement of any real EMS journey.

checks.name: routes_are_connected
checks.detail: Every one of 52955 route steps follows an existing connection.

checks.name: no_illegal_grade_transitions
checks.detail: No route changes grade except at a ramp or a deck touchdown.

checks.name: departures_within_demand_window
checks.detail: 0 vehicle(s) depart outside the configured demand window

checks.name: unresolved_infrastructure_usage_recorded
checks.detail: 192 vehicle(s) route over OSM way(s) whose operational status Phase 2.5 could not establish (['1351994264']). Their travel times are conditional on a fact nobody has verified. Excluding the infrastructure instead would isolate a 1.9 km carriageway, so it is left enabled and counted.

checks.name: traffic_enters_at_boundary_sources
checks.detail: All traffic enters at the 8 documented boundary source edges.

checks.name: traffic_leaves_at_boundary_sinks
checks.detail: All traffic leaves at the 6 documented boundary sink edges.

checks.name: simulation_terminated_correctly
checks.detail: Simulation reached 3900.0s of a configured 3900.0s over 7800 steps

checks.name: insertion_backlog_is_small
checks.detail: 0 of 3226 vehicles were still waiting to be inserted at the end. A large backlog means the network could not accept the configured demand, so the traffic simulated is lighter than the configuration asked for.

checks.name: teleports_within_threshold
checks.detail: No teleports. Every recorded travel time is the time the vehicle actually spent driving its route.

checks.name: teleport_observations_match_sumo
checks.detail: The control loop observed 0 teleport(s); SUMO reports 0. A mismatch means the loop missed some, and an unobserved teleport cannot be attributed to a trip.

checks.name: ambulance_completed_its_route
checks.detail: The ambulance completed its route in 148.5s (0.5s waiting, 20.2s time loss)

checks.name: ambulance_was_not_teleported
checks.detail: The ambulance drove its whole route without being teleported.

checks.name: background_trips_completed
checks.detail: 2937 of 3225 trips completed. Vehicles still running at the end are expected: demand runs to the end of the window, so the last departures cannot finish.
